html:
Friday we had the best surprise. Caitlin Gilliland of J.D. Barnes, Enterprises, Inc showed up at our office with a plate of cookies and brownies and an envelope full of awesome!

We officially received notification that we’ve won the 2015 Best Places to Work Award from the Charlotte Business Journal. This award is presented to “outstanding companies whose benefits, policies and practices are among the area’s best.”

We’re very excited to have won this award. We strive to create an environment of excellence and this award validates that we hit the mark.

From a description of how winners are chosen, “Let’s face it, it’s hard work linking bottom-line company goals with what your employees care about most to create a strong emotional connection to your business.” Can’t say it any better than that.

We care immensely about our culture! We hire employees to push the envelope, lend a helping hand, who have strong work ethic and care about what they’re doing. This attitude of excellence extends to our clients, services and products. We look forward to winning this award many times over.

“We will chase perfection, and we will chase it relentlessly, knowing all the while we can never attain it. But along the way, we shall catch excellence.” – V. Lombardi.
